status: Fixed before full student/control training and confirmation assessment
loss: normalized mixture NLL + 0.2 masked execution future-change SmoothL1 + 0.2 frozen outcome decode SmoothL1
training_mode_assignment: Teacher-label responsibility for auxiliary outcome loss only; tokens themselves are predicted student means.
checkpoint_selection: Lowest development mean of normalized latent MSE, terminal MSE, visual procedure MSE, geometric procedure MSE; evaluate every 5 epochs plus epoch 1.
causal_information_gate: Streaming/future/reset audit; terminal and procedure each >=10% below train-mean context, paired 95% episode-bootstrap benefit CI >0, retaining >=50% of teacher-over-mean benefit at 25-70% anchors.
history_advantage_gate: Information gate plus terminal and procedure each >=5% below both independently trained current and short controls, paired benefit CI >0; wrong-history action error exceeds same-task-history error with CI >0.
confirmation_unlock: Passing development causal-information gate; bind exact teacher/student/cache hashes before confirmation. History gate can fail and must be reported separately.
confirmation_limit: Same episode split already characterized for teacher. No student selection uses confirmation. This is not a fresh scene/session/task-disjoint final benchmark.
scope: Causal representation milestone; frozen action decoder diagnostic only. No policy integration, simulator handover, automatic takeover threshold, or TTT replacement.
